risk_summary: The company reports no revenue-generating activities in 2018 or 2019 and remains dependent on completing and commercializing the Bakersfield Biorefinery. Funding for Camelina production has not been secured, while projected liquidity and profitability depend on future financing, construction, and product commercialization. Quantified historical financing and cost disclosures improve transparency, but forward-looking assumptions and substantial execution risk remain.
